ops.oldText: Before engaging another provider, Customer must disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.
ops.newText: Before engaging another provider, Customer is not required to disclose and match for Vendor any more favourable commercial offer it receives.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We have flipped the operator in Section 7.2 so that disclosing and matching a competing offer is not required of us; as drafted it was an open-ended right of first refusal and de facto exclusivity on our sourcing, with no product-category or time limit and no performance-based exit. It also contradicted Section 12.3, in which Cobalt acknowledges we have made no exclusivity or most-favoured-customer commitment; our position is no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation on Customer, and the exclusivity running in our favour is untouched.
proposal.summary: Negate the Section 7.2 disclose-and-match operator so no exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds Customer.
